welcome.backup: I'll make sure to keep backups of my data.

settings.importDescription: Import accounts or export a backup
settings.syncDescription: Sync accounts through encrypted files in a cloud folder

appearance.trayDescription: Quickly copy codes while Tauthy is running

security.passwordDescription: Set a password for unlocking your vault
security.autoLockDescription: Lock app after 1 minute of inactivity
security.deleteVaultDescription: Remove this device's vault; exported backups and sync files remain

import.importDescription: Import accounts from a backup or text file
import.exportEncryptedDescription: Protect a portable Tauthy backup with a password

sync.description: Sync accounts through a Tauthy Sync folder in your cloud storage. Each device writes its own encrypted file inside it, so simultaneous changes do not collide. Local changes work offline.
sync.createDescription: Choose a cloud-synced location; Tauthy creates a Tauthy Sync folder there
sync.joinDescription: Select a Tauthy Sync folder, or a folder containing one older sync file
sync.createPasswordDescription: You will need this password to connect another device or recover your accounts. Tauthy cannot recover it for you.
sync.joinPasswordDescription: Enter the recovery password used when this sync was created.
sync.mergeConflictedCopyDescription: Recover changes from a file your cloud service marked as conflicted. The selected file is kept.
sync.disconnectDescription: Stop syncing without deleting local accounts or sync data
sync.disconnectWarning: This device will stop syncing. Your local accounts and encrypted sync data will not be deleted. Continue?

modals.password: Choose a password for your encrypted vault
modals.passwordInsecure: Password should be at least 8 characters
modals.importPasswordDescription: Enter the password used to encrypt this {{format}} backup.
modals.exportPasswordDescription: Choose a password you will remember. Tauthy cannot recover it for you.
modals.deleteWarning: Delete the vault on this device? Its accounts and sync connection will be removed. Exported backups and files in your sync folder will remain.
modals.exportWarning: This export is not encrypted and contains your authentication secrets. Store it securely. Continue?

toasts.importEncryptedAuthenticationFailed: The password is incorrect, or the backup has been damaged or modified.
toasts.importEncryptedCorrupt: The encrypted backup is corrupted or has been modified.
toasts.importEncryptedUnsupported: This backup version or encryption configuration is not supported.
toasts.importEncryptedNoPasswordKey: This backup has no password key and can only be unlocked by its original app.
toasts.importTauthyNewerVersion: This backup was created by a newer version of Tauthy. Update Tauthy and try again.
toasts.importTauthyDuplicateIds: This backup contains duplicate account IDs and cannot be imported safely.
toasts.importTauthyIdConflict: An account in this backup conflicts with a different local account using the same ID.
toasts.importIdConflict: An account in this file has the same ID as a different local account.
toasts.importUnsupportedOtp: The file contains OTP formats Tauthy does not support yet. Only 6-digit SHA-1 TOTP entries with a 30-second period can be imported.
toasts.importFailed: Import failed. Check the file and the selected format.
toasts.importOtpAuthTooLarge: The URI list is too large (maximum 1 MiB).
toasts.importOtpAuthTooMany: The URI list has too many accounts (maximum 500).
toasts.syncConflictMerged: Conflicted copy merged. Keep it until all devices show the recovered accounts.
toasts.syncAuthenticationFailed: The sync recovery password is incorrect, or the file was modified.
toasts.syncConflict: The local and synced vaults contain an account conflict that cannot be merged safely.
toasts.syncCorrupt: The sync data is damaged or invalid.
toasts.syncDeviceFileInvalid: Can't read {{file}}. It may be incomplete, damaged, or from another sync. Keep a copy before changing it; your local vault is safe.
toasts.syncDeviceFileLimit: Sync has more than 32 device files and is paused. Keep the files and make an encrypted backup before seeking help; don't delete device files blindly.
toasts.syncFileExists: A Tauthy Sync folder already exists there. Join it or choose another location.
toasts.syncMultipleFiles: This folder contains multiple sync files. Choose a folder with only one older sync file.
toasts.syncPickerFailed: The location picker could not be opened.
toasts.syncUnavailable: The sync location is currently unavailable. Check that your cloud folder is accessible.
toasts.syncUnsupported: This sync file version or encryption configuration is not supported.
toasts.syncFailed: Sync failed. Your local vault was not lost.
toasts.syncBackgroundFailed: Automatic sync could not finish. Open Settings → Sync for details.
